Name: Mini Bars - Healthbars Mod
Author: GukelZ
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=6]DESCRIPTION:[/size][/color][/b]

Just a customizable healthbar mod that add custom healthbars to most part of the monsters.


[color=#6aa84f][size=6][b]MOD FEATURES:
[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Different healthbars to each monster.
[*]Option to show healthbars only in mobs inside range.
[*]Option to change the healthbars theme.
[*]Option to show healthbars if the monsters aren't full health.
[*]Commands to change the values inside the game.
[/list]

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=6]CONFIGURATION:
[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]Bars_Theme:[/color] Changes the theme between [color=#b6d7a8]mini(1)[/color] and [color=#b6d7a8]long bars(2)[/color].
[*][color=#b6d7a8]Show_Full_Life:[/color] Shows the healthbars if the monsters are full life.
[*][color=#b6d7a8]Range_Verification:[/color] Shows the healthbars if the monsters are in a certain range.
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8]* Please, if you're changing the [/color][color=#6aa84f]Bars_Theme[/color][color=#b6d7a8] option, use only "[/color][color=#6aa84f]1[/color][color=#b6d7a8]" or "[/color][color=#6aa84f]2[/color][color=#b6d7a8]" to define the theme.
* All of this configurations can be changed by commands too.[/color]
